integrity_note: Complete proof and a standalone finite verifier are supplied. Finite checks corroborate but do not prove universal statements; priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Known-position erasures only; indexed cyclic binary integer sums of width exactly two, no noise or unknown erasure positions. Single-path ambiguity and one-erasure results are prior literature; this claim concerns multi-erasure masks, their sharp placement and aggregate census. Equivalent graph-sum statements may exist outside the checked sources.
title: Complete multi-erasure ambiguity and placement laws for cyclic binary pair-sum reads
